detail.title: Bravo LT500 Height-Adjustable Standing brown Desk with Wheels - 60x40cm
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Bravo LT500 is a height-adjustable standing desk purpose-built for walking pad and treadmill workstations, with a 60 x 40cm desktop that comfortably fits a laptop, tablet and other daily essentials. Height adjusts smoothly between 70-90cm, letting you switch between sitting and standing to improve posture and cut fatigue during long work, study or gaming sessions. Smooth-rolling caster wheels with locking brakes let the desk move easily between rooms and lock firmly in place once positioned, while its compact footprint and sturdy steel frame suit home offices, bedrooms, apartments and dorms alike. Beyond standing work, it doubles as a laptop desk, writing desk, bedside table and presentation stand, making it a genuinely versatile addition to any home setup.
